# entitlements API

What the account's plan allows; usage and limits.

Base path `/api/v1/entitlements` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/entitlements.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/entitlements.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### entitlements

#### GET /api/v1/entitlements/accounts

**Accounts**

Accounts with a plan row, oldest first, with their effective plans (operators).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offset` | query | integer | no | min 0; default `0` |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | min 1; max 200; default `50` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AccountPageOut](#accountpageout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/entitlements/accounts/{account_id}

**Get Account**

One account: what applies, the assignment and its history (operators).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AccountDetailOut](#accountdetailout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/entitlements/accounts/{account_id}/plan

**Assign Plan**

Assign a plan by hand (operators): history row, `entitlements.plan.changed`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [AssignmentIn](#assignmentin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AccountDetailOut](#accountdetailout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/entitlements/features

**Features**

Every feature key the modules declare (retired keys included).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [FeatureOut](#featureout) |

#### GET /api/v1/entitlements/me

**Me**

The plan, status, limits and features that apply to the caller's account now.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ResolvedOut](#resolvedout) |

#### GET /api/v1/entitlements/plans

**Plans**

The plans on offer (public: a pricing page needs no login).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [PlanOut](#planout) |

#### GET /api/v1/entitlements/plans/{key}

**Get Plan**

One plan (operators), also an inactive one.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | path | string | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PlanDetailOut](#plandetailout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/entitlements/plans/{key}

**Put Plan**

Create or replace a plan (operators); every service drops its cached snapshots.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | path | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PlanIn](#planin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PlanDetailOut](#plandetailout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

## Schemas

### AccountDetailOut

One account for operators: what applies, the assignment and its history.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `account_name` | string or null | yes |  |
| `assigned` | [AssignedOut](#assignedout) or null | yes |  |
| `effective` | [ResolvedOut](#resolvedout) | yes |  |
| `history` | array of [HistoryOut](#historyout) | yes |  |

### AccountOut

An account in the operator list: its assignment and what applies (no mower data).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `account_name` | string or null | yes |  |
| `assigned` | [AssignedOut](#assignedout) | yes |  |
| `effective` | [ResolvedOut](#resolvedout) | yes |  |

### AssignedOut

The stored assignment of an account.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `grace_until` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `plan` | string | yes |  |

| `source` | [PlanSource](#plansource) | yes |  |
| `status` | [PlanStatus](#planstatus) | yes | Stored status (time does not change it). |
| `trial_until` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `updated_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |

### AssignmentIn

Body of `PUT /accounts/{id}/plan`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_name` | string or null | no |  |
| `grace_until` | string (date-time) or null | no | End of a grace period; default now plus the grace days. |
| `plan` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 64 |
| `reason` | string | yes | Why (kept in the history).; min length 1; max length 500 |
| `status` | [PlanStatus](#planstatus) | no | default `"active"` |
| `trial_until` | string (date-time) or null | no | End of a trial; default now plus the plan's trial days. |

### PlanDetailOut

A plan for operators: also the features no module declares and where it came from.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | yes |  |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `description` | string or null | yes |  |
| `features` | array of string | yes | Feature keys; `*` grants every feature. |
| `from_plan_file` | boolean | yes | Seeded from the plan file (a changed file entry overwrites it at the next start). |
| `is_default` | boolean | yes |  |
| `key` | string | yes |  |
| `limits` | [PlanLimits](#planlimits) | yes | Limits; null means unlimited. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `trial_days` | integer | yes |  |
| `unknown_features` | array of string | yes | Feature keys of the plan that no module declares (kept, they gate nothing until a module enforcing them is deployed). |
| `updated_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |

### PlanIn

Body of `PUT /plans/{key}`: the whole plan.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | no | default `true` |
| `description` | string or null | no |  |
| `features` | array of string or string | no | max items 500 |
| `is_default` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `limits` | [PlanLimits](#planlimits) | no |  |
| `name` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 200 |
| `trial_days` | integer | no | min 0.0; max 365.0; default `0` |

### PlanSource

Who set an account's plan.

Type: `"default"` \| `"manual"` \| `"billing"`

### PlanStatus

Status of an account's plan.

Type: `"active"` \| `"trial"` \| `"grace"` \| `"expired"`

### ResolvedOut

The plan that applies to an account now.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `billing_enabled` | boolean | yes | False: billing is disabled on this installation and every account has the plan `unlimited`, whatever was assigned. |
| `features` | array of string | yes |  |
| `grace_until` | string (date-time) or null | no |  |
| `limits` | [PlanLimits](#planlimits) | yes |  |
| `plan` | string | yes |  |
| `plan_name` | string | yes |  |
| `since` | string (date-time) or null | no |  |
| `source` | [PlanSource](#plansource) | yes |  |
| `status` | [PlanStatus](#planstatus) | yes | Effective status (an ended trial is `expired`). |
| `trial_until` | string (date-time) or null | no |  |
